title: 垄断：市场势力与价格歧视

claims.claim: Monopoly persistence is associated with legal, technological or market barriers to entry; natural monopoly may reflect scale economies over the relevant market range.
claims.notes: monopoly itself is distinguished from anticompetitive conduct

claims.claim: A single-price monopolist faces downward-sloping demand, has MR below price, and chooses output where MR=MC before reading price from demand.
For P=100−Q and MC20, Qm40 Pm60, Qc80 Pc20, monopoly CS800 PS1600 and DWL800.
claims.notes: linear demand, constant marginal cost, no fixed cost or externality

claims.claim: Group demands PA=80−QA and PB=60−0.5QB with MC20 imply discriminatory (QA,PA)=(30,50), (QB,PB)=(40,40).
claims.locator: MIT OCW Monopoly II; chapter 15 worked example
claims.notes: price discrimination mechanism independently calculated; welfare comparison is model-specific

claims.claim: Market power, segmentation/self-selection and limited resale support price discrimination; third-degree pricing sets segment MRs equal to common MC.
claims.locator: MIT OCW Monopoly II session overview and materials
claims.notes: conditions are model conditions; not every price difference is discrimination
